descriptionChirho: Proper noun שֵׁרֵבְיָה (Sherebiah): a Levite who returned from Babylonian exile with Ezra and participated in the covenant renewal (Ezra 8:18, 24; Neh 8:7; 9:4-5; 10:12; 12:8, 24). S143921 covers bare and conjunctive forms (7x), while S143923 is a single prepositional use 'for/to Sherebiah'. All translations preserve the same anthroponym: eng Sherebiah, spa Serebías, hin शेरेब्याह, arb شِيرِبْيَا, kor 쉐레비야/세레비야, swa Sherebia. The preposition is syntactic, not a distinct meaning.
